name: Containers
description: Manage your Docker engine (Colima, Docker Desktop, OrbStack, Podman, Rancher Desktop or any Docker context) and the Compose stacks, containers, ports and logs of the active worktree from Orca's right sidebar.

cover.alt: Containers panel in Orca's sidebar: engine card and All view, with container cards showing ports, CPU and memory

screenshots.alt: Engine card with the Switch engine list and its running and stopped counts, above the All view grouped by project and worktree
screenshots.caption: Switch engines and see what runs

screenshots.alt: Individual containers with published ports, dashed internal-only ports, and exit 1 and restarting markers
screenshots.caption: Ports and health at a glance

screenshots.alt: A worktree's detail view with Up, Restart and Down for its Compose stack, and ports, CPU, memory, logs, stop and shell per container
screenshots.caption: Run a Compose project from the sidebar

screenshots.alt: Live logs open inside two container cards, and docker logs in an Orca terminal
screenshots.caption: Live logs in each card and Open in terminal
